preconditions.description: The number of knights n must be between 1 and 1000 inclusive.

postconditions.description: The output must contain exactly n lines, each representing the coordinates of a knight.
Each line of output must contain exactly two integers representing the coordinates of a knight.

postconditions.expression: all(-10**9 <= int(line.split()[0]) <= 10**9 and -10**9 <= int(line.split()[1]) <= 10**9 for line in stdout.splitlines())
postconditions.description: The coordinates of each knight must be within the range of -10^9 to 10^9.

postconditions.expression: len(set((int(line.split()[0]), int(line.split()[1])) for line in stdout.splitlines())) == n
postconditions.description: All knights must be placed in different cells, ensuring no duplicate coordinates.
The final number of knights after the process must be at least floor(n^2 / 10).
